admin.permissionHint: Section access is set per user. Open the shield icon to allow or deny each part of the application.
admin.roleDefaultsReadOnly: Only a super administrator can change a role's defaults, because the change applies to every user holding that role.
admin.roleMatrixHint: Select a role to change its defaults. A filled circle means the role has that section by default; a per-user override can still narrow it.
admin.rolesSubtitle: A role sets the default section access and the ceiling a per-user override cannot lift.
admin.scopeHint: The data scope limits which part of the organisation the user sees. It is separate from section access: a user may be allowed Sales and still see only their own region.
admin.searchUsers: Search name, username, email or employee ID
admin.sectionLocked: Restricted to administrator roles; no per-user override can grant it.
admin.title: Administration
admin.usersSubtitle: Create users, assign a role, a data scope and section permissions.
ai.emptyBody: Answers come from the data warehouse — never invented.
ai.feedbackSanitized: Your note was saved with instruction-like text removed.
ai.placeholder: Ask about sales, material stock or targets…
ai.title: AI Assistant
alerts.title: Alert Center

auth.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
auth.subtitle: Sign in to view your business reports
common.noData: No data found for the selected filters.
confirm.blocked: This cannot be removed while these records depend on it:
confirm.question: Are you sure you want to remove this record?
confirm.retireConsequence: The record is hidden from this table and can be restored at any time. Nothing is deleted, and every transaction that references it keeps working.
confirm.voidConsequence: The transaction is reversed and disappears from every report, dashboard and export at once. The row itself is kept, with your reason, and can be reinstated.
credit.agingNote: Reporting date minus due date. Open invoices only.
credit.asOnNote: As on {date} · {count} invoice(s) in scope. Net Invoice, Balance, Due Date and Status are calculated by the backend and cannot be edited.
credit.flagShownNotHidden: Flagged rows are shown, not hidden. The figures are the source's own.
credit.noPaymentEvents: Nothing has been posted against this invoice.
credit.title: Credit Control
customers.title: Customer Analytics
dashboard.title: Executive Dashboard
dataManagement.description: Browse and maintain the records already in the warehouse. Master data is retired rather than deleted; transactions are voided rather than removed.
dataManagement.noAccess: You don't have access to any data management table.
dataManagement.noEntities: Nothing in this group is available to you.
dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataQuality.title: Data Quality
error.body: The page could not be displayed. Try reloading.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to access this information.
error.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist.
error.sectionDenied: This section has not been enabled for your account. Ask your administrator if you need it.
error.title: Something went wrong
filters.autoSelected: Automatically selected from the item you chose below it.
history.empty: Nothing has changed since this record was loaded.
learning.answeredByHelp: The report that answers this question. Only the tool is reused — the period and filters come from whoever asks next.
learning.entityCodeHelp: Must be a code the master data already has — an alias names a record, it cannot create one.
learning.examplesHelp: A question and the tool that answered it correctly. Used to choose a tool, never to produce a figure.
learning.mode.question: This question
learning.noAliasesBody: Teach a phrase from the review queue and it will appear here awaiting approval.
learning.noExamplesBody: Worked examples appear here once they are proposed.
learning.noSignalsBody: The assistant has not failed on anything it recorded. New problems appear here as they happen.
learning.question: Question
learning.queueHelp: Most frequent first. Teaching a phrase writes a proposal — it does not take effect until it is approved.
learning.queueTitle: What the assistant could not handle
learning.subtitle: Questions the assistant handled badly, and the vocabulary approved from them.
learning.title: Agent Learning
learning.vocabHelp: Only active terms are read, and only where the master data has no answer of its own. Retiring one is reversible.
map.adminLevelsHint: Administrative boundaries are switched on from the map's own layer control.
map.bandFilterHint: Points the server could not score have no band and stay on the map.
map.controlsHint: Boundaries and reference layers change what is drawn. They never change the filter.
map.countsHint: Everything the current filter selects, whether or not its layer is switched on.
map.diagnosticsHint: Development only: shows the selected filter and the ancestors, descendants and entities it resolved to.
map.historyActualsOnly: Actual sales only. Targets are set by month of a financial year, not by date, so there is no monthly target to compare against.
map.layersHint: Layers control what is drawn. The filter decides what is in scope — hiding a layer never narrows it.
map.locationApproximate: Approximate location, derived from {count} placed customers
map.metricNotScored: Not measured at this level. Sales are aggregated for the organisational levels; pick a higher Sales level to see a figure.
map.modeNeedsAchievement: Sales Achievement needs an achievement metric. Achievement is actual divided by target, a business calculation, and this application does not perform those in the browser.
map.modeNeedsPromotion: Promotion Activity has no data in this platform: there is no campaign or promotion record to place on a map.
map.modeNeedsVolume: Sales Volume is summed in the warehouse but is not published as a map metric yet.
map.noAreaMetric: No figure is available for this area.
map.noLocationsBody: The master data carries a location name but not a latitude and longitude. Upload a Map Locations file — placing the territories is enough, because every level above them is derived automatically.
map.noLocationsTitle: No coordinates have been loaded yet
map.pointDetailEmpty: Click a point on the map to see its detail.
map.rankEmpty: Nothing to rank under the current filters.
map.rankNoTarget: Ranked by net sales: no target covers this level in the selected period.
map.searchHint: Filters what is drawn, not what was measured.
map.searchNoMatch: Nothing on the map matches that.
map.stockDefault: No stock is attributable to this area yet, so the configured default is shown. It switches to the measured figure as soon as a warehouse here is placed on the map.
map.title: Business Map
map.unplacedHint: These have data for the period but no coordinate, so they are counted in the total and listed here rather than hidden.
marker.builderHint: Click the canvas to add a point, drag a point to move it, select one to edit or delete it.
marker.deactivated: Design deactivated. The entity falls back to the system default.
marker.deleteSystemDefault: System default — it cannot be deleted, because it is the fallback that keeps the map from drawing blank. Duplicate it, or assign a different design instead.
marker.designerSubtitle: Design a marker without writing code. The preview is rendered by the same code the map uses.
marker.label: Label
marker.legendHint: The legend is built from the same configuration the map draws with, so it follows any design change automatically.
marker.librarySubtitle: Every marker the business map draws, and which entity each one is assigned to.
marker.mapPreviewNote: A schematic map for judging the marker at map scale — drag to pan, use + and − to zoom, click a marker to select it. Nothing here changes the saved design.
marker.nameRequired: Give the design a name before saving.
marker.noAssignments: Nothing assigned yet — every entity uses its system default.
marker.noDesigns: No marker designs yet. Create one to get started.
marker.priorityHint: Priority: a design assigned to a specific entity wins over one assigned to the entity type, which wins over the system default.
marker.resetConfirm: This removes the custom marker assignment for this entity type and restores the system default. The design itself is kept. Continue?
marker.uploadHint: SVG is preferred. Uploads are sanitised: scripts, event handlers and external references are removed.
materials.title: Material Analytics
notifications.title: Notifications
performance.title: Performance
permissions.explainer: Choose Allow or Deny for each section. Leaving a section on its role default means it follows the role, so a later change to the role reaches this user too. The backend applies the same rules to every request, so denying a section here also blocks the API behind it.
permissions.scopeNote: Section access decides which pages a user may open. Which records they see inside them is set by the data scope.
permissions.scopeSeparate: The data scope is applied on top of section access: allowed sections still return only this user's part of the organisation.
permissions.subtitle: Allow or deny each part of the application.
permissions.title: Section Permissions
profile.name: Name
profile.title: Profile
record.noCoordinate: No coordinate has been set for this record.
record.retiredNotice: This record was retired by {by}. Restore it to use it again.
record.voidedNotice: This transaction was voided by {by}. Reason: {reason}
sales.title: Sales
stock.noData: No stock data found for the selected filters.
stock.nothingExpiring: Nothing is expired or near its shelf life for this scope.
stock.snapshotNote: The current position as last uploaded. Stock carries no posting date, so no period applies to it and none is offered.
stock.title: Material Stock
stock.unitNote: Every figure is the uploaded stock value itself, reported as KG/LTR — named in each label, and never converted.
table.noRecords: No records match the current filters.
table.resizeColumn: Drag to resize, double-click to fit
table.selectPage: Select all rows on this page
target.title: Target
targetMgmt.adjustedFromSystem: A management adjustment moved this from the system figure of {system}.
targetMgmt.adjustmentsHelp: An adjustment names a node and an absolute volume — +500, -1200 — and is funded by that node's siblings, so the country target never moves. It is an input to the engine and takes effect on the next run.
targetMgmt.allocationHelp: The engine allocates Target Volume down to customer, month by month, using two years of actual sales. Quantity and Value follow from the allocated volume — they are never allocated directly.
targetMgmt.appliesNextRun: Applies on the next allocation run — nothing has moved yet.
targetMgmt.approval.chainDescription: A target is allocated downwards and reviewed upwards: the first step is the sub-territory and the last is Management.
targetMgmt.approval.commentHint: Optional when approving; required when rejecting or sending back.
targetMgmt.approval.historyDescription: Every act on this version, oldest first. Nothing here is ever edited or removed.
targetMgmt.approval.notYourTurn: This target is with {role}. Your step opens once theirs is done.
targetMgmt.audit.description: Every action taken on this target, newest first. Nothing here is ever edited or removed — a correction is a new entry.
targetMgmt.audit.empty: No actions have been recorded yet.
targetMgmt.audit.title: Audit trail
targetMgmt.cannotReachCustomer: Cannot perform customer-level allocation — the customer hierarchy mapping is incomplete. Volume will be allocated to the deepest level the master data supports, and labelled as that level.
targetMgmt.compare.changeUndefined: A node present on only one side has no difference to state.
targetMgmt.compare.countryDescription: The figure a person entered on each side. A movement in the allocation is explained first by asking whether the country target itself moved.
targetMgmt.compare.notInBase: This node has no target in the earlier version — added, not zero.
targetMgmt.compare.notInHead: This node has no target in the later version — removed, not cut to zero.
targetMgmt.compare.percentUndefined: A percentage against a zero or absent figure is undefined.
targetMgmt.compare.pickPrompt: Choose an earlier version to compare this one against.
targetMgmt.countryHelp: You enter Target Volume. Quantity and Value are calculated from the Material Master — they are never typed.
targetMgmt.createHelp: A plan fixes the scope: financial year, period, company, business unit and sales line. There is one plan per scope — a changed target is a new version of it, never a second plan.
targetMgmt.createNote: Creating a plan starts version V1 as a draft. Nothing is written to the warehouse until a version is locked.
targetMgmt.dashboard.attentionDescriptio: Each of these is waiting on somebody for a stated reason.
targetMgmt.dashboard.noPlans: No target plans yet. Create one on the Planning tab.
targetMgmt.dashboard.queueSummary: {versions} target(s) at your step, and {revisions} revision request(s) routed to you.
targetMgmt.deletePlanConfirm: Delete {plan}? Its draft country target goes with it. This cannot be undone, though the audit trail is kept.
targetMgmt.deletePlanHint: Remove this draft plan. Only possible while it has never been allocated, submitted or locked; typed country target figures do not stop it. The audit trail is kept.
targetMgmt.exceedsLimit: Allocation exceeds the configured maximum row limit.
targetMgmt.growthUndefined: Growth needs a volume in both years. Growth from nothing is undefined, not infinite.
targetMgmt.historyHelp: Two financial years of actual sales, read under your own data scope. Contribution % is each material's share of the later year's volume, and is the default basis where growth sits within {guidance}%. Nothing here is estimated — a material with no sales reads n/a, never zero.
targetMgmt.level.label: Level
targetMgmt.lock.blockedTitle: This target cannot be locked yet
targetMgmt.lock.description: Locking writes the agreed allocation into the warehouse. From that moment the Target page, every export and the AI assistant read these figures, and a corrected transfer price can no longer change them.
targetMgmt.lock.heldBy: Locking is held by {role}, the last step of the approval chain.
targetMgmt.lock.lockedHelp: A locked target is never edited. To change it, create the next version and take it through approval again.
targetMgmt.lock.title: Lock this target
targetMgmt.lock.written: {written} target rows now stand — {inserted} new, {updated} restated, {voided} withdrawn.
targetMgmt.matrix.description: Who signs at which level, in what order, and how far each may move a figure before it has to go higher. A blank sequence means the role sits outside the chain entirely.
targetMgmt.matrix.outsideChain: Outside the approval chain — configures the workflow, signs nothing.
targetMgmt.matrix.restoreHint: Fills the form with the shipped chain. Nothing is saved until you press Save, and the change is audited like any other edit.
targetMgmt.matrix.title: Approval matrix
targetMgmt.mismatchedNodes: {count} node(s) do not agree with the sum of their children. Final approval stays blocked until every level reconciles.
targetMgmt.missingDerivation: Quantity and Value cannot be derived: {materials} state no Conversion Factor or Transfer Price.
targetMgmt.neverAllocated: This version has not been allocated yet.
targetMgmt.noActualsYet: No actual sales have been recorded for this period yet, so achievement cannot be computed. It is never shown as 0%.
targetMgmt.noAdjustments: No management adjustment has been set.
targetMgmt.noConversionFactor: This material states no Conversion Factor, so Quantity cannot be derived from Target Volume. Load it through the Material Master upload.
targetMgmt.noCountryLines: No materials on this target yet. Add one to enter its volume.
targetMgmt.noEditAction: Your role may view this target but not change it.
targetMgmt.noHistoryReason: The allocation engine is waiting for transactional sales data. Nothing has been allocated, and no figures have been estimated.
targetMgmt.noHistoryRows: No sales history and no country target for this plan's scope yet.
targetMgmt.noRuns: No allocation has been run for this version yet.
targetMgmt.noSalesInYear: No sales recorded for this material in {year}.
targetMgmt.noSalesLastYear: This node recorded no sales in the previous basis year.
targetMgmt.noTargetSet: No country target has been set for this material yet.
targetMgmt.noTransferPrice: This material states no Transfer Price, so Value cannot be derived from Quantity. Load it through the Material Master upload.
targetMgmt.noTree: This version has not been allocated yet, so there is nothing to review.
targetMgmt.notReadyBody: {count} condition(s) below must be resolved first. Nothing has been generated and the current target is unchanged.
targetMgmt.pickPlanFor: Choose a plan from Target Planning to see {what}.
targetMgmt.pickPlanWhat.approval: where it stands in the approval chain
targetMgmt.pickPlanWhat.history: the sales history it will be allocated by
targetMgmt.plansHelp: Select a plan to see its version history.
targetMgmt.queue.emptyMessage: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
targetMgmt.queue.revisionsDescription: Requests routed to you. Granting one moves the figure immediately, funded by the node's siblings, so the country target does not change.
targetMgmt.queue.versionsDescription: Including those not yet at your step, so a target you know exists never simply disappears.
targetMgmt.revision.reasonHint: Required. It travels with the request and is what the approver reads.
targetMgmt.revision.title: Request a revision
targetMgmt.revision.volumeHint: Enter the volume you are asking for. Thousands separators are fine.
targetMgmt.revision.willEscalate: This is larger than your ±{limit}% limit, so the request will be escalated to a role that can approve it rather than refused.
targetMgmt.salesNeverChecked: This run stopped before it read any sales, so nothing is known either way.
targetMgmt.someRowsNoVolume: Some sales rows state no volume, so this figure is the sum of the rows that did — the real total is higher.
targetMgmt.subtitle: Build a target: fix the planning scope, then version it through approval.
targetMgmt.title: Target Management
targetMgmt.totalDerived: Derived from Conversion Factor and Transfer Price.
targetMgmt.totalSuppressed: Only {derivable} of {count} materials can be derived, so a total would be short by an unknown amount.
targetMgmt.totalVolumeHint: The primary input — entered, not calculated.
targetMgmt.upload.applied: {file} applied: {created} added, {updated} changed. {untouched} material(s) already on this version were not named in the file and keep their figures.
targetMgmt.upload.blankMeaning: This material is listed with no Target Volume. A blank means nothing is stated for it — it keeps whatever figure the version already holds, and is never written as zero.
targetMgmt.upload.description: The same figures, entered from a spreadsheet. Nothing is applied until you have seen what the file would change — and a file with any unreadable row applies nothing at all, because a country target loaded in part is short by whatever the rest was worth.
targetMgmt.upload.noCurrent: This material has no figure on this version yet.
targetMgmt.upload.templateHint: A CSV of this plan's own materials, pre-filled with the figures this version already holds. Materials with no figure yet are left blank.
targetMgmt.upload.title: Load from a file
targetMgmt.versionFrozen: This version has been approved or locked, so its figures are read-only. Create the next version to change them.
targetMgmt.versionsHelp: An approved target is never overwritten. A change creates a new version, which starts from the country volumes of the one before it.
targetMgmt.withHistoryHint: Materials the allocation can distribute by past sales.
upload.activity.note: Imports run on the server. You can leave this page, use the rest of the application or refresh the browser — the job carries on and reappears here.
upload.activity.title: Upload Activity
upload.cancelAlreadyFinished: This run had already finished, so there was nothing to cancel. The result below is what actually happened.
upload.cancelConsequence: The run stops at its next checkpoint and its transaction is rolled back, so nothing from this file reaches the warehouse. Existing data is untouched and the file can be uploaded again.
upload.cannotImport: Fix the errors and upload the file again before importing.
upload.confirmHint: {rows} valid row(s) will be imported. Invalid rows are not loaded.
upload.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv) only, up to {size}.
upload.modeHint: Insert adds new records only. Insert or update also refreshes existing ones. Nothing is ever deleted.
upload.previewNote: The first 50 rows are shown; the whole file was validated.
upload.progress.title: Upload progress
upload.qualityNote: Warehouse data quality across every import batch. Rejected rows never entered the fact tables.
upload.rollbackConfirm: Rolling back removes the records this import loaded. This cannot be undone. Continue?
upload.subtitle: Upload master and transactional data. Every file is validated before anything reaches the warehouse.
upload.title: Data Upload Center
upload.tooLarge: This file is {size} and the limit is {limit}. Split it into smaller files and upload them one at a time.
volume.none: No volume recorded for this period.
volume.title: Total Volume
volume.unmeasured: {count} line(s) carry no Total Volume in the source data and are not included.
